structure_proposals.why: Your two leg days run the same lifts from the fourth one on, so Legs A gives up the hanging leg raise and keeps the cable crunch while Legs B keeps both, which finally makes the two days different and takes tonight from 24 sets down to 22.
On 2 September you pressed dumbbells in this slot and wrote 'New gym. No smith machine. Dumbbell press', so the Push B opener takes the name of the lift you are actually doing.
This has sat at the same 10 pounds since the middle of August without the reps climbing, and Push B already gives you three sets of dumbbell lateral raises.
